mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts, as measured by HOUST, indicates a growing demand for housing and related goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4% indicates a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production, as measured by INDPRO, indicates a growing supply of goods, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in retail sales, as measured by RSAFS, and a decline in the unemployment rate, as measured by UNRATE, indicate a growing demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 3% and a decline in the consumer price index, as measured by CPIAUCSL, indicate a tightening monetary cycle and low inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle with low inflation
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in tightening periods with low inflation are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in payroll employment, as measured by PAYEMS, indicates a growing labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in GDP growth, as measured by GDPC1, below 2% indicates a slowing demand for goods and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of slow GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).
